label: ISO/IEC 27005:2022 — Information security risk management
citation: ISO/IEC 27005:2022, Guidance on managing information security risks
body: ISO/IEC 27005:2022 provides the consequence-and-likelihood structure underpinning the matrix approach used by this wizard: risks are analyzed by assessing the potential consequences of an event and the likelihood of its occurrence, and risk levels are derived from the combination of the two — commonly presented as a consequence x likelihood matrix. The standard deliberately leaves the number of scale levels and the risk-acceptance thresholds to the organization applying it.
